<h1 align="center">Hi there 👋, I'm Apurba Saha</h1>
<h2 align="left">🕵️‍♂️ About Me</h2>

I'm a **Software Development Engineer** at [Amazon Web Services](https://aws.amazon.com/linux) in the **Amazon Linux** org. Before that, I spent over two years at [Chaldal (YC W15)](https://chaldal.com/) building delivery and logistics systems that optimizes routing in Bangladesh. I completed my undergraduate degree in **Computer Science and Engineering** from **BUET** in 2023. I have **7 years** of competitive programming experience and **3+ years** of professional experience.

- 🐧 At AWS, I co-launched [***Supplementary Packages for Amazon Linux 2023 (SPAL)***](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/linux/al2023/ug/spal.html), which delivers 2,800+ source packages to help customers migrate off Amazon Linux 2, and was featured at ***AWS re:Invent***. I also built the automated service that imports open-source packages into Amazon Linux's build infrastructure with provenance and security scanning.
- 🛒 At Chaldal, I architected Bangladesh's first ***10-minute grocery delivery*** system and built a last-mile routing algorithm that raised the on-time delivery rate from ***67% to 82%***. I also built a warehouse task scheduling algorithm that raised dispatch reliability from ***83% to 90%***.
- 🧩 I enjoy solving complex algorithmic problems. I represented my country at the ***ICPC World Finals*** twice, placing ***36th globally*** in 2024 (Luxor, Egypt) and ***50th globally*** in 2022 (Dhaka, Bangladesh).
- 🏆 I am rated ***Master*** on [***Codeforces***](https://codeforces.com/profile/Roll_Num_56) (max 2242) and ranked ***180th*** in ***Meta Hacker Cup 2023***.
- 🔬 I have previously worked on theoretical computer science research to solve the ***Parameterized String Matching with Mismatch Tolerance*** problem.
- 🌟 I love designing and building complex systems and feel fortunate to witness the advancement of technologies.

<h2 align="left">♟️ Featured App: Chess Mortem</h2>

**[Chess Mortem](https://github.com/diponsaha007/chess_mortem_public)** is an Android app I built that explains your chess games in plain English, for free and offline.

- 🗣️ Every move gets one line on what happened, like "That allows your opponent to trap the knight on h5". Board code looks for 60+ chess concepts, such as forks, pins and trapped pieces, and a small ranker trained on labelled moves picks the one worth saying.
- 🔍 Stockfish scores every move on your phone, and the app grades each one from Brilliant to Blunder.
- 📴 Everything runs on the device, so it works without an internet connection.
- 🤖 For longer explanations, add a key from a free LLM API provider. The model is grounded in the coach line and the facts the engine and board code found, so it explains what's there instead of making things up, even with free models.
